blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Cebu Regional Football Association (CRFA) is bringing in UEFA Pro-licensed coach Alex España to give local coaches, schools, and clubs some guidance to strengthen their coaching programs. España will begin his activities in Cebu with the CRFA Coaches Assembly and meet-and-greet scheduled on Saturday, September 26, at the Cebu City Sports Center. He’s the current first-team head coach of Gala FC in Macao, China. More than 100 CRFA coaches are expected to attend the gathering, which will formally introduce España and outline the objectives of his visit.
